title: v1: Learning to Point Visual Tokens for Multimodal Grounded Reasoning

access.version_evidence: Cover: arXiv:2505.18842v7 [cs.CL] 5 Aug 2026; header Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026. The title prefix v1 names the model, not the arXiv revision.
sections_read: p.4 3 Visual Grounding Decays During Reasoning

rs.innovation_approach: 把仅生成文本的自回归输出空间扩为词表 token 与原输入视觉 patch 位置的并集；复制被选 patch 的连续 embedding 作为下一步输入，配合显式视觉引用 SFT 数据。
rs.key_step: 以两个线性投影计算 query–patch logits，与原 LM logits 拼接成单一输出分布；选中 pointer 后回填原 patch embedding。
rs.why_non_obvious: 原 pointer-generator 将复制对象映射回离散词表，不能直接表示连续视觉输入；本方法改为位置引用，去掉两空间间的插值门。
rs.trigger_condition: When a decoder has meaningful continuous input embeddings but intermediate reasoning needs explicit re-access, apply position pointing and embedding copying to expose the relevant input again in the generated context.
reviewer_praise: 旧 ICLR 审稿 nUEgoOyWKd 肯定仅增两个线性头的低结构开销（reviews_evidence[0]）。
旧 ICLR 审稿 0YLUJRjTZ2 肯定 v1g 的潜在资源价值（reviews_evidence[1]）。
reviewer_concern: 旧 ICLR 审稿 ptxzVLRWIk 质疑相对 coord 方法的优势证据（reviews_evidence[2]）；当前 v7 Table 2 已非该表。
旧 ICLR 审稿 nUEgoOyWKd 质疑注意力衰减即模型缺陷的解释（reviews_evidence[3]）。
旧 ICLR 审稿 0YLUJRjTZ2 质疑外部生成数据与自主调用可靠性（reviews_evidence[4]）。
rs.acceptance_signal: manifest 决策原样 reject；ICLR 2026 meta-review 主要剩余关切为范围/通用性和 tool use。该评审对应旧稿，修订版未知；本地 v7 自称 COLM 2026 conference paper，不覆盖 manifest，也不能把旧评审当成 v7 评审。
rs.abstract_strategy: Extend the output space with references to existing continuous inputs and copy selected representations into the evolving context.
rs.abstract_key_step: Concatenate ordinary output logits with position-selection logits, then replace a selected reference with its original continuous representation.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: A copy distribution over discrete symbols cannot directly retrieve continuous representations; index their positions instead of forcing a vocabulary mapping.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When intermediate inference needs renewed access to already encoded evidence, predict references in a shared output space and reinsert the corresponding representations.

signatures.object: 自回归输出空间和下一步输入 embedding
signatures.information: 当前 decoder hidden state、已有文本历史、初始图像 patch embeddings；不获得更高分辨率新像素，不调用外部 detector，不具有当前决策的反事实收益真值。
signatures.operation: 将词表 logits 与经 Lq/Lk 缩放点积产生的 patch-position logits 拼接；解码为 pointer 时把对应原 patch embedding 放回推理流。
signatures.output: 文本与指向原视觉 patch 的连续表示交替组成的推理序列。
signatures.claimed_effect: 作者报告 MathVision-mini 23.6→34.5；同一训练后禁用 pointing 为25.3（Tables1–2）。这不是仅头结构的孤立训练消融。
conditions: 有可复用的连续图像 embedding
主要为 Qwen2.5-VL-7B；附录 Gemma3-4B 迁移
复制内容来自原图编码，不是 crop 后重编码

evidence.quote: On the subsequent decoding step, the input embedding at position t is replaced with the continuous vector ck , enabling the model to attend directly to the referenced content.

signatures.failure_boundary: App B/Fig6 报告 wrong-region、under-copying、high-count copying、ambiguous targets；不能因此推出最少裁图或必要性学习。

signatures.object: 已有文字推理 trace 的视觉引用标注与 SFT 支撑
signatures.information: TVC 中 QVQ 生成的推理 seed、Gemini-2.0-flash 分解出的对象描述、原图及离线 grounding；没有行为必要性反事实或最终策略的需求标签。
signatures.operation: 把文本中视觉引用改写为 detect 查询、缓存对象 ID，过滤不匹配/不唯一/≤2对象/不良格式，将框映射到 enclosed patch pointer 序列后监督训练。
signatures.output: 约300K条带 interleaved grounding 的 v1g 训练样本；约82%分解样本保留。
signatures.claimed_effect: 作者报告 copy-token accuracy 首 epoch 已趋饱和；Table9 推理 pointing correctness 82.7%、appropriateness 87.7%。该人工适当性不是因果必要性。
conditions: 可描述和可框定的视觉引用
离线 LLM 分解和 grounding 标注
过滤规则偏向至少3个对象

evidence.quote: The model collects and rewrites each visual reference as a detect call, which takes a short natural-language description and returns the corresponding image region. Retrieved regions are cached and assigned symbolic identifiers such as <objX> in order of appearance.

signatures.failure_boundary: App C 指出非结构化领域缺少 seed 与对齐；Table10 的 NEVER skip 规则与对象数过滤可能改变行为覆盖，后者为读者推断而非实验结论。

signatures.object: 用于构造训练数据的 query-conditioned attention map
signatures.information: 离线 Qwen2.5-VL 对对象描述和去掉对象名称提示的两次 attention；不使用人工目标框指导生成；模型 attention 不等于当前训练策略的观测需要。
signatures.operation: 计算逐 image-token 的 A/A′ 对比，寻找峰值，对候选 crop ratios 扫描并选择内外 contrast sharpness 最大的框。
signatures.output: 语义描述对应的 bounding box，再转为 pointer 监督。
signatures.claimed_effect: 100个抽样数据样本、3位专家评分：correctness 83.3% vs GroundingDINO 29.3%，但 comprehensiveness 55.0%、tightness46.0%（Table8）。
conditions: 经验选层与候选框比例，具体数值未报告

evidence.quote: Identify the peak region in R. Sweep over multiple candidate crop ratios; for each ratio, form a bounding region around the peak. Select the bounding box maximizing contrast sharpness between inside and outside regions. Convert the selected region to image-coordinate bounding box b.

signatures.failure_boundary: 只有高层伪代码；层集合、crop ratios、sharpness 精确定义、A′近零处理未给出。不能把该图直接当作 crop reward 或 necessity mask。

limitations.text: 缺少结构化推理 seed 会限制跨域。
limitations.quote: These domains often lack structured reasoning traces, making data collection more difficult.
limitations.locator: p.17 Appendix C Beyond mathematical domains

limitations.text: RL/弱监督检索尚留待未来，并未提出GRPO方法。
limitations.quote: We leave this exploration to future work due to current resource constraints.
limitations.locator: p.17 Appendix C Weak supervision and reinforcement learning

limitations.text: 可访问视觉证据不等于解决定位和符号推理。
limitations.quote: These cases indicate that point-and-copy improves access to visual evidence but does not by itself resolve localization ambiguity or long-horizon symbolic reasoning.

question.observed_failure: 作者在 RefCOCO testA 的 TVC-7B attention 诊断中报告，目标框 token 平均 attention / 全图 token 平均 attention 在中段趋于约0.8；注意力下降是观测，不能单凭此建立推理错误的因果机制。
question.load_bearing_assumption: 仅初始编码并把视觉表示放在固定上下文，足以支撑后续纯文字推理的持续视觉定位。作者挑战这一设计，但没有证明所有MLLM都因该假设失效。
question.scope: 具有可定位局部视觉证据的多模态数学推理；补充 EMMA physics/coding 和 Gemma3 迁移。
question.success_criterion: 在数学benchmark准确率提高，pointing开关与文本预算对照支持动态视觉重访的作用；附加评估grounding正确性和推理成本。
question.why_open: 相关工作依赖固定视觉上下文、结构化坐标或外部工具；传统pointer-generator的离散词表复制不能直接输出连续视觉embedding引用。

moves.quote: To train v1, we require fine-grained multimodal reasoning traces in which each step is grounded to specific visual evidence.
All variants share the same Qwen2.5-VL-7B backbone:
This design supports unified inference over discrete and continuous modalities without modifying the core architecture (Figure 2).

equations.locator: p.8 §5 Training unnumbered z-loss (printed without square; visually checked)

objective.signal_routing: SFT conditional next-token prediction over text and image-position targets. Box annotations become sequences of supervised pointer targets; selected pointer embeddings reuse image features. No reward, advantage, turn-level credit or RL mask is specified. Exact prompt/image loss masks and weighting between text/pointer positions are not reported.
objective.normalization: other: scaled dot-product 1/sqrt(D), softmax over concatenated output logits; top-40 log-partition regularizer; not group reward normalization.
objective.invariance: Original embedding table and language generation head dimensions are retained; output support and sequence inputs change through added pointer logits/heads. No policy-optimality invariance or potential-based shaping theorem.
objective.baseline_or_potential: No policy-value baseline or potential. A′ in annotation is attention under object-name-removed prompt, not a critic and not a reward baseline.
objective.degenerate_cases: No GRPO all-correct/all-wrong groups. Inference disabling pointing leaves a trained model with text-only outputs and lowers MathVision-mini to25.3. A′=0 handling is not reported; attention-ratio singularity is a reader-identified implementation unknown.

evidence_design.discriminating_experiment: Table2 同训练pointing on/off：34.5 vs25.3；Table6文本预算从8192→12800只使24.0→24.7，同12800预算v1为34.5。前者有训练-测试分布改变，后者不是所有数据/架构因素都相同的因果隔离。
controls: 同 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 未微调23.6与grounded-training后禁pointer25.3
Gemma3表使用OpenCompass参考分，不是本地匹配重训baseline
Table7 RL compute仅参考，作者明确不是受控baseline

negative_results.text: 高计数问题中16次pointing仍无法正确计数。
negative_results.quote: calls across the answer options without resolving the count.
negative_results.locator: p.17 Appendix B Failure cases (continued paragraph)

negative_results.text: 短训练产生重复和不完整答案。
negative_results.quote: shorter training runs produced unstable behaviors such as repetition and incomplete reasoning without a final answer.

evidence_design.falsifier: 读者提出的判别条件（未执行）：匹配监督数据、训练预算和输出预算的文本/坐标重访对照若达到同等收益，或真实pointer与同成本随机patch控制无差异，会削弱pointer特异作用解释；注意力下降若不预测受控错误也削弱grounding-decay解释。

setup.framework: other: HuggingFace Transformers + DeepSpeed; batched vLLM reported for inference

engineering.cost: 作者报告300K×5epochs、约672 A100-equivalent GPU-hours。Table3 HF TVC 4057 total tokens/143.42s vs v1 4087 total tokens(990 copy)/154.04s; batched vLLM23.86s vs25.65s。约7%时间开销；1.6×是训练数据统计推得的保守上界（App A），不是测得的运行token倍数。

pitfalls.text: 长推理trace使过短训练重复/无终答，作者沿用5epoch；pointer行为本身首epoch已饱和。
pitfalls.quote: copy behavior required relatively little data and typically saturated within the first epoch, as indicated by an early plateau in copy-token accuracy.

engineering.lesson: 当复用连续视觉证据需要模型主动输出时，应先提供该行为的明确监督并校验局部grounding与成本；pointing会提升重访能力，但不会自动给出最少必要调用。

relevance.how: 明确构造pointer行为再SFT，提供行为支撑路径；不证明能通过RL恢复缺失直答/弃答。
grounded合成trace用人工correctness/comprehensiveness/tightness审计，揭示监督噪声；不能将模型标注称人工金标。
attention-contrast可供离线框质量候选，但论文不是过程奖励且没有crop必要性判定。
复用视觉证据可能支持利用，但失败案例仍有符号推理错误，未直接解决正确caption与错误答案映射。
100数据样本与100推理输出的3专家人工评测可迁移为审计结构；保留较低κ和tightness。
